create_object_sampler: create an ObjectSampler to sample objects from a set and place them on receptacles in a Habitat scene
sample_receptacle: sample a Receptacle from the allowed receptacle sets using the ObjectSampler's sample_receptacle method
sample_placement: sample a valid placement position for an object on a Receptacle using the ObjectSampler's sample_placement method
single_sample: sample a single object placement by selecting a Receptacle then an object and placing it via single_sample
sample_multiple_objects: sample multiple object-receptacle pairs in a scene using the ObjectSampler's sample method with a ReceptacleTracker
